Gerry Williams gained selection for the County team and finished an excellent 58th at Leicester, ahead of such runners as Hyman, Heatley and Bullivant.

Besides Gerry Williams's effort at Leicester we had, of course, our two leading Surrey mem Gerry North and John Thresher picking up nothing less than team winner's medals; with Gerry taking the individual bronze and leading Surrey to victory just as he did Lancashire in 1960 and 1962.

Gerry Williams ran very well, lying between 4th and 7th throughout, and was well supported by John Bicourt. Bill Dance, now free from his achilles trouble, was all out for a trip to Belgium and forged through the field in the later stages.
